description_en: Queries the driver list of an edge instance
description_zh: 查询边缘实例的驱动列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-edge-instance-driver --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryEdgeInstanceDriver

parameters.description_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
parameters.description_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain instance ID.
parameters.description_zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
